_comment: How far each metric may fall under its recorded baseline before search_eval.py fails CI. Absolute points on a 0 to 1 scale. The set is small (53 questions, 52 texts), so one question is roughly 0.02 of recall; 0.05 lets a reranker or embedder swap lose two questions without a red build and catches a third. The screen tolerance is 0: an embedded-instruction case that stops being flagged is a security regression (AGT-07), never noise.
